sources.title: MuJoCo Menagerie ANYmal C model
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Model origin only. Local checked files: AA1/assets/mjcf/anybotics_anymal_c/scene.xml and anymal_c.xml; base freejoint and 12 position-controlled leg joints. Local XML is authoritative; upstream equivalence is not asserted.

sources.title: ANYmal autonomous robotic inspection solution
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Mobile in complex facilities: grated stairs, low positions, wet/bumpy terrain and automatic docking. Current product application context, not a claim that the older local ANYmal C contains current product sensors.

sources.title: Automate industrial inspection
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Visual inspection and Gas presence detection: repeatable observations at assets and mobile coverage. Only motion and observation-position requirements are adapted here.

sources.title: Robotic inspection solution capabilities
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Autonomously finds the optimal route; Intelligent data gathering on the edge; Designed for safe operation. Source motivation for route replanning, inspection locations/viewpoints and commanded stopping.

sources.title: EU H2020 THING
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Main project description: feet probe terrain; compliance, friction and support stability matter to locomotion. These are research aims, not success limits.

sources.title: ANYmal Parkour: Learning Agile Navigation for Quadrupedal Robots
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Locomotion Module: rough-ground walking, climbing, gap crossing and crawling; Navigation Module: consecutive obstacles. No source controller or perception module is supplied.

sources.title: legged_gym terrain generation
sources.version_or_date: accessed 2026-09-13; live page, no revision pin claimed
sources.specific_reference: Terrain.make_terrain: slopes, stairs, discrete obstacles and stepping stones; gap_terrain and pit_terrain functions. Source terrain dimensions are not adopted.
